about.title: A Love for Baking that Speaks All Languages
about.subtitle: Meet the Baker
about.p1: Hello, I am Yevheniia. Born on October 19, 1993, in Ukraine, my passion for fine pastry and custom baking blossomed early in my family kitchen. To me, baking is not just a profession, but a delicate form of art – a way to craft sweet memories for lifetime milestones.
about.p2: Today, I bake in my warm, aesthetic studio in Bern, Switzerland. Here, I combine my beloved Ukrainian baking heritage and traditional family recipes with modern Swiss quality and the finest organic, local ingredients. Every single cake is an individual masterpiece designed around your theme and flavors.

flavors.title: Our Signature Flavors
flavors.subtitle: Carefully selected sponge and filling combinations for ultimate taste

medovyk.name: Classic Medovyk
medovyk.desc: A traditional Ukrainian specialty. Multi-layered honey biscuit sheets baked to perfection, filled with a light and refreshing sour cream frosting. Delightfully soft.

pistachio.name: Pistachio & Raspberry
pistachio.desc: Fragrant and moist pistachio sponge, paired with vibrant, tart raspberry coulis and a smooth pistachio mascarpone cream.

caramel.name: Salted Caramel Crunch
caramel.desc: Deep chocolate sponge filled with our homemade liquid salted caramel, hazelnut praline crunch, and chocolate mousse.

mango.name: Mango Passionfruit Dream
mango.desc: Fluffy vanilla sponge cake layered with a tropical mango and passionfruit cream, covered with vanilla cream cheese frosting.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Important info about orders, logistics, and ingredients
faq.q1: How far in advance should I place my order?
faq.a1: For wedding cakes, we recommend ordering 2-3 months in advance. For standard celebration cakes and bento cakes, please send your request at least 7-14 days prior to your preferred date.
faq.a2: Yes, we offer delivery for large wedding and corporate cakes in Bern and the surrounding regions (fees depend on distance). Small cakes and bento cakes are to be picked up at our Bern studio.
faq.q3: Do you offer gluten-free, lactose-free or vegan options?
faq.a3: Yes, most of our flavors can be prepared gluten-free, lactose-free, or vegan. Please note your requirements clearly in our order inquiry form.
faq.a4: To secure your slot, we require a 50% deposit after design details are finalized. The remaining 50% is due prior to pickup or delivery via Twint or bank transfer.
